checks: opaque lease prepares a typed captured material plan
loading cannot publish partial appearance and unchanged plan is omitted
prepared receipt atomically publishes UV pose size and independent uniforms
invalid instance uniform cannot mutate the accepted revision
submission is distinct and live movement retains ownership
new epoch invalidates prior submission receipt
idempotent caller release preserves visible entity demand
hide drops last entity demand and invalidates commit
failed tick keeps admitted feedback and rolls back appearance revision
fractional epoch input is rejected by actual Core
limitations: Actual production WASM Core with recorded host receipts; no GPU, scanout, FPS or global leak/GC certification.
Source ingestion exercises the runtime API; this gate does not certify the latest CLI precompiler or a complete SDK.
